metadata.portion_note: Gram quantities are synthetic benchmark portions chosen to vary examples. They are not clinical recommendations or serving guidance.
metadata.evidence_note: Food composition fields retain their reviewed source IDs and URLs. USDA nutrient records do not establish allergen absence.

food_composition.title: USDA FoodData Central individual food records

allergen_context.title: FDA Food Allergies
allergen_context.scope: Used only for the general distinction that almonds are tree nuts; catalog ingredient and allergen evidence remains item-specific.
